question: Which exact 3.1.28 entry point posts a system notification (lvx_notification_insert_message), what message struct does it consume, who owns the strings, from which thread may it be called, and what icon files does it accept?
prototype_hypothesis: CANDIDATE port record 0xC11F31C (EVID-PORT-1028-001) with the Band 10 Pro 3.101.043 int(const firmware_notification_message *) contract and 88-byte layout.
callsite_evidence: Entry 0xC52DAD0 (Thumb, PUSH.W {R4-R9,LR}): NULL branch logs '[%s] %s: Msg is NULL' with tag notification_manager and __func__ 'lvx_notification_insert_message' (literal 0xC52DBAC -> 0x2C77D120); reminder branch logs under 'lvx_notification_start_reminder'.

0xC52DAD0 -> lvx_notification_init_message 0xC473550: malloc(88) 0xC3280F8, memcpy 88, +0x2c == 0 -> current seconds (0xC513228), +0x20 NULL -> '/resource/app/notifications/default_small.bin', +0x1c NULL -> '/resource/app/notifications/default.bin', both replaced by lv_mem strdup copies (0xC471750).
-> insert_message 0xC4735C0 ('insert message the uid is %llu, id is %lu'): per-uid group in lv_ll 0x20086DFC, at most 20 messages per uid; node filled by 0xC4733BC.

After insert: 0xC4720C4 (list trim); if u8 +0x50 != 0 a one-entry copy list is published as event 31 type 7 through 0xC4585A4(31, &0x200AC760, 1); uv_timer_start 0xC1C0142(0x200B3AD0, 0xC4718D4, 500, 0) unless that timer is already active; 0xC4720A0 frees the temporary.

draw_reminder_view 0xC4F3430: header label +0x0c, icon +0x1c (0xC2B25D4 -> lv_image_set_src), title via get_logo_title_text 0xC2B48E0 (+0x10, focus context only when u8 +0x52 != 0). For a single item it calls +0x48(msg, parent, +0x54) when non-NULL, else focus view 0xC53D140 or stock detail 0xC4F2824. list_get_type 0xC2B3940 reads +0x54 only for focus items; normal items use +0x10/+0x14 and cache the text height in +0x30.

Stock callers (19 xrefs): add_miss_notification 0xC4EF8C8 (+0x0c 'phone.appname', +0x10 'missed.phone', +0x14 caller, +0x1c '/resource/app/notifications/phone.bin'); low battery start_notification 0xC33DB14 (+0x0c 'battery.appname', +0x10 title, +0x14 text, +0x20 icon, +0x38 = 0, +0x48/+0x4c callbacks); recorder interrupt 0xC4F2D80 likewise.
Port record refuted: 0xC11F31C is bes_i2c_transfer ('chip/bes_i2c.c' assert).
control_flow_evidence: lv_bin_decoder_info 0xC2F3B28 (lvgl/src/libs/bin_decoder/lv_bin_decoder.c) reads a 12-byte lv_image_header_t; magic != 0x19 goes through the legacy converter 0xC2C36DC (v8 cf 4 -> RGB565 0x12, cf 5 -> ARGB8565 0x13)

fields.meaning: uid: group key; bit 63 marks phone-originated
text-height cache, written by the list view, not copied
callback paired with +0x48 (detail destroy on the sibling 3.1.190 build)
focus/resident flag (+0x54 then read unchecked as a focus context)

ownership_analysis: The firmware copies the 88-byte struct and strdups every string before returning; caller storage may be on the stack and released after the call.
context_analysis: Unlocked lv_ll list, uv timers on the app loop initialised in miwear_init_appdata and a synchronous event-31 publish that builds the reminder page: UI/app-loop thread only.
icon_analysis: Icons are file paths for lv_image_set_src; stock paths are absolute Vela paths such as /resource/app/notifications/phone.bin. This build runs LVGL v9 (lv_image_decoder.c, lv_bin_decoder, ARGB8888 blending): a .bin icon should carry the native 12-byte v9 header (magic 0x19, e.g. ARGB8888 0x10, w, h, stride), which is what watchfaces/canopus-installer/manager_icon.bin already is and what build_canopus_supervisor.sh copies unchanged for this target. A legacy v8 header is accepted but reinterpreted as RGB565 / ARGB8565, so an ARGB8888 v8 file would render wrong. NULL icons get firmware defaults.
differences_from_043: Field offsets match the Supervisor's .043 struct (start_reminder +0x50, callback_data +0x54, callbacks +0x48/+0x4c).
+0x0c is the app/source line and +0x10 the title; the .043 struct names +0x0c 'title' and +0x10 'source'.
The return value is free() residue; treat it as void.
Image format is LVGL v9 (magic 0x19), unlike 3.1.32 / 3.1.190.
unsafe_assumptions: +0x38/+0x40/+0x44/+0x4c semantics inferred from stock writers and the sibling 3.1.190 build; all zero for the Supervisor's use.
That the Supervisor UI task runs on the same app loop is inferred, not observed on a device.
recommended_probe: Mirage (emulator evidence only): post one notice from the Manager UI with +0x50 = 1 and all callbacks NULL; confirm popup and notification-centre entry; then on a device.
